name: 06704 · Waterbury, CT
findings: ZIP 06704 (Waterbury) has 73 nonprofit organizations. 17 of them (23%) list at least one way to get involved in their tax returns or on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 9 organizations.
Social and fraternal organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (29% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 06704 (Waterbury) has fewer organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: Fewer organizations list membership
observations.text: Per resident, fewer organizations in ZIP 06704 (Waterbury) list membership in their tax returns or on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 36% of the typical level).

confidence.text: Based on 25 organizations here; 30% of all organizations here have no identified type.
